events.event_name: Scoop the City Ice Cream Truck Tour
events.address: Mobile route; see date-specific stop details
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile ice-cream truck tour highlighting NYC neighborhoods from Piece of Cake Moving and StreetEasy's 2026 neighborhood data, with free ice cream and sweepstakes-style giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Free ice cream treats are advertised at each scheduled stop while supplies last. Visitors can also enter to win Knicks tickets, restaurant gift cards, MTA passes, merchandise and other prizes; prize entry does not guarantee a win.
events.caveats: The official host schedule says the truck is open to the public and hands out free ice cream, but treats are first-come/while supplies last at each stop. The truck moves throughout the day, so use the date-specific route rather than a single address.
events.practical_notes: September 12 Manhattan stops: 11–11:45 AM Greenwich St & Duane St; 12:15–1 PM E Houston St & Chrystie St; 1:30–2:15 PM Avenue A & St. Marks Pl; 2:45–3:30 PM W 15th St & 10th Ave; 4:05–6 PM W 77th St & Amsterdam Ave. September 13 Brooklyn/Queens stops: 11–11:36 AM Prospect Park West & 15th St; 12:06–12:42 PM Carroll St & Smith St; 1:02–1:38 PM Myrtle Ave & St. Edwards St; 1:53–2:28 PM Fulton St & Bond St; 3:13–3:49 PM Myrtle Ave & Seneca Ave; 4:19–4:54 PM Skillman Ave & 43rd St; 5:24–6 PM 51st Ave & Center Blvd.

events.event_name: Beauty Break with Urban Outfitters and Yes Day
events.address: Urban Outfitters, 1333 Broadway, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A three-hour Urban Outfitters and Yes Day beauty break with an Aura photo booth, Dirty Soda Bar, bouquet bar and product customization.
events.what_is_free: The Eventbrite listing says the photo booth, Dirty Soda Bar, bouquet bar and other activations are free while supplies last. Customization by Original Rose is complimentary only with a Yes Day purchase.
events.caveats: Urban Outfitters' Eventbrite page confirms the event, time and address and does not state organizer approval. Free activations are while supplies last. Customization is not a no-purchase freebie: it requires a Yes Day purchase.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–3 PM at Urban Outfitters, 1333 Broadway. A live Eventbrite registration page is available; no organizer-selection or approval step is established in the verified listing.
